basic_info.description: Experience elevated city living in this upgraded 2-bedroom + den, 2-bath residence at The Infinity, one of San Francisco's premier high-rise communities. This deluxe home showcases sweeping water views through dramatic wall-to-wall curved windows and is thoughtfully designed with high-end finishes and modern upgrades throughout.    The open-concept living and dining area features hardwood flooring and an expanded kitchen island, perfect for entertaining. The chef's kitchen is outfitted with sleek Studio Becker cabinetry, dark gray granite countertops, and premium stainless steel Bosch appliances.    Both bedrooms are spacious and filled with natural light from large windows. The primary suite is a serene retreat, featuring stunning water views and a spa-like bathroom with a dual-sink vanity, Studio Becker cabinetry, travertine limestone tile, a deep soaking tub, and a walk-in shower.    Residents at The Infinity enjoy world-class amenities including a 5,000 sq. ft. fitness center, recently remodeled club lounge, private movie theater, business center, and 24-hour doorman service.    Ideally located in the heart of South Beach, you're just steps from the Embarcadero waterfront, Salesforce Park, top restaurants, grocery stores, and convenient transit options.
